units_per_core.conditions: One Cube unit in the published Ascend-Max core diagram; not a claim about later 910B/910C architectures.

macs_per_cycle.version: Communications of HUAWEI RESEARCH, June 2022; original Ascend 910 / Ascend-Max; audited 2026-11-14 America/Los_Angeles
macs_per_cycle.conditions: Slides list 8192 INT8 MACs as Cube geometry; Table 5 reports 8192 floating-point operations/cycle, not INT8 MAC/cycle. Neither directly validates the modeled sustained INT8 accumulation service; not inferred from geometry or rounded chip TOPS.

units_per_core.version: Communications of HUAWEI RESEARCH, June 2022; original Ascend 910 / Ascend-Max; audited 2026-11-14 America/Los_Angeles
units_per_core.conditions: One Vector unit in the published Ascend-Max core diagram; not a claim about later 910B/910C architectures.

fp32_ops_per_cycle.version: Communications of HUAWEI RESEARCH, June 2022; original Ascend 910 / Ascend-Max; audited 2026-11-14 America/Los_Angeles
fp32_ops_per_cycle.conditions: Table 5 reports 256-byte vector width; older slides list 256 ops/cycle without an unambiguous FP32 operation convention. Width and mixed-precision peak do not establish this FP32 service rate.

units_per_core.version: Communications of HUAWEI RESEARCH, June 2022; original Ascend 910 / Ascend-Max; audited 2026-11-14 America/Los_Angeles
units_per_core.conditions: Dedicated vs shared SFU organization not confirmed; vector special-function support is documented, but separate SFU inventory and operation-specific service are not specified.

fp32_ops_per_cycle.version: Communications of HUAWEI RESEARCH, June 2022; original Ascend 910 / Ascend-Max; audited 2026-11-14 America/Los_Angeles
fp32_ops_per_cycle.conditions: No SFU operator model in this GEMM entry; vector special-function support is documented, but separate SFU inventory and operation-specific service are not specified.

gm_l1.conditions: Integrated effective GM-to-core path, including external memory effects; no additional HBM/NoC time is added; published port widths and nominal chip bandwidths do not establish this path's sustained payload rate.

output_path.description: Model a packed INT32 L0C->UB->GM export service. Source supports L0C/vector/UB dataflow, but exact raw INT32 export instruction sequence and service still require target/CANN validation.

architectural_cores.conditions: 32 Ascend-Max cores in original Ascend 910 compute die; architectural inventory, not available cores for every SKU.

l2_bytes.conditions: Source labels on-chip buffer 32 MB. Mapping it to shared L2 and interpreting MB as MiB remain assumptions; no cache behavior is modeled.
l2_bytes.version: Huawei DaVinci presentation, 2020, PDF p19; audited 2026-11-14 America/Los_Angeles

hbm_bytes.version: Huawei DaVinci presentation, 2020, PDF p20; audited 2026-11-14 America/Los_Angeles
hbm_bytes.conditions: Source reports 32 GB HBM Gen2. Exact GB/GiB normalization for the modeled product is unresolved; raw published capacity is preserved in calibration/parameter_source_audit.json.

l2_bytes_per_cycle.version: Communications of HUAWEI RESEARCH, June 2022; original Ascend 910 / Ascend-Max; audited 2026-11-14 America/Los_Angeles
l2_bytes_per_cycle.conditions: Conflicting published LLC totals: 94 GB/s per core in Table 5 (~3 TB/s for 32 cores), 4 TB/s total in section 4.1.3; 2020 slides report 3 TB/s. Unresolved accounting; no single normalized L2 rate selected.

hbm_bytes_per_cycle.version: Communications of HUAWEI RESEARCH, June 2022; original Ascend 910 / Ascend-Max; audited 2026-11-14 America/Los_Angeles
hbm_bytes_per_cycle.conditions: Derived normalization of published aggregate HBM bandwidth: 1.2e12 byte/s / 1e9 reference core cycles/s = 1200 byte/cycle. Decimal TB/s; chip aggregate nominal inventory only. Not an HBM clock or a per-core GM transfer service rate.

noc_bytes_per_cycle.version: Communications of HUAWEI RESEARCH, June 2022; original Ascend 910 / Ascend-Max; audited 2026-11-14 America/Los_Angeles
noc_bytes_per_cycle.conditions: 4x6 mesh; each adjacent-node link is 1024 bit at 2 GHz, reported 256 GB/s. This is a link rate, not the chip aggregate rate required by this field.

interconnect_bytes_per_second.version: Huawei DaVinci presentation, 2020, PDF p20; audited 2026-11-14 America/Los_Angeles
interconnect_bytes_per_second.conditions: PCIe 3.0 x16, HCCS and 100G RoCE interfaces are listed; they do not establish one chip-aggregate effective payload bandwidth.
